# Chart

A picture of numbers: comparison, trend, share or spread.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Multi-brand</span> Multi-brand draws on core, content and media families, not data. It admits only families in its roles. Its scenarios are signing up and managing a plan. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a>, <a href="./badge">Badge</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** The story is a relationship in a set of numbers, not a single number.
- **Not when:** A table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart is decoration.

Instead:

- [Table](./table.md): The numbers as rows; often needed beside the chart.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A number in a table</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.body</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A mono font</div></div><div class="cap">Numbers read like text in every brand.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The same numbers are available as a table or text; color is not the only key. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add chart
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Chart reads 13 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Chart's tokens to change Chart alone.

<div class="odv-tlegend"><span class="odv-themed">Changes with theme</span><p>Multi-brand decides what changes when you switch theme.
